instruction: A candid action photograph with a low-angle full shot of an indoor gym with gray mats. On the left, the man in the black and yellow athletic wear (R1) stands leaning forward, looking down. On the right, the man in the gray t-shirt (R2) lies on his back on the mat, facing upward with his legs raised defensively. The standing man (R1) grips the raised leg of the grounded man (R2) to control his movement. In the background, the legs of blurred bystanders and several camera tripods are visible. The lighting is neutral and overhead, casting soft shadows on the gray floor.
